Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses I. THIS BID IS FOR SPECIFIC MAKE “M/S. CARL ZEISS AG, GERMANY” AND NO OTHER MAKE OR MODEL IS A CCEPTABLE FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS: II. "Since CARL ZEISS AG is the original manufacturer of the FESEM and the sole owner of the S martSEM software, communication architecture and system integration protocols, the propos ed upgradation can only be carried out by the OEM or through its local office in India” III. OUR CASE FILE NO. DPS/CRPU/VECC/32805 IV. IN ORDER TO AVOID THE REJECTION OF BID/QUOTATION, BIDDERS ARE ADVISED TO SUBMIT THE BID WITHOUT MENTIONING ANY PRICE OR ANY TAXES, LEVIES, DUTIES IN TECHNICAL BID. AS PER GEM, ALL Q UOTES SHALL BE INCLUSIVE OF THESE ELEMENTS AND BIDDERS SHALL SUBMIT PRICE ELEMENT(S) IN FINA NCIAL BID ONLY. V. THE BIDDER SHALL UPLOAD A DOCUMENT/DECLARATION INDICATING THE PERCENTAGE OF LOCAL CON TENT OF THE ITEM BEING QUOTED ON LETTER HEAD DULY STAMPED & SIGNED AS PER FORMAT (ANNEXU RE-XI) ATTACHED UNDER BUYER ATC, WHICH IS MANDATORY. VI. VEHICLES WITH GPS FACILITY WILL NOT BE ALLOWED ENTRY INSIDE PURCHASER’S PREMISES. IN VIEW OF THE ABOVE, THE CONSIGNMENTS SHOULD BE DISPATCHED ONLY THROUGH VEHICLES WITHOUT GPS S YSTEM. VII. THE ORDERED ITEMS SHALL BE SUPPLIED TO THE RESPECTIVE STORES ONLY ON WORKING DAYS AND BETWEEN 10:00 HOURS TO 16:00 HOURS EXCLUDING SATURDAYS, SUNDAYS AND PUBLIC HOLIDAYS. THE SUPPLIER SHALL GIVE ADVANCE INTIMATION TO THE CONSIGNEE THROUGH EMAIL BEFORE DELIVERING T HE MATERIAL. VIII. OFFER SHALL BE QUOTED STRICTLY AS PER OUR SPECIFICATION, OFFER VALIDIITY, DELIVERY PERIOD,

UNIT MENTIONED ABOVE AND TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER BID/GEM GTC. IX. PSD CLAUSE: SUCCESSFUL BIDDER CAN SUBMIT THE PERFORMANCE SECURITY IN THE FORM OF BANK GUARANTTEE OR ACCOUNT PAYEE DEMAND DRAFT ALSO. IN CASE OF DEMAND DRAFT, IT SHOULD BE MA DE IN FAVOUR OF PAY & ACCOUNTS OFFICER, VECC PAYABLE AT KOLKATA. AFTER AWARD OF CONT RACT, SUCCESSFUL BIDDER CAN UPLOAD SCANNED COPY OF THE DEMAND DRAFT IN PLACE OF PSDBG AN D HAS TO ENSURE DELIVERY OF HARD COPY OF THE ORIGINAL DEMAND DRAFT TO THE BUYER ASSTT. PU RCHASE OFFICER, CRPU, 1/AF BIDHAN NAGAR, KOLKATA – 700 064 WITHIN 15 DAYS OF AWARD OF CONTR ACT. X. BIDDER'S OFFER IS LIABLE TO BE REJECTED IF THEY DON'T UPLOAD ANY OF THE CERTIFICATES / DOCUMENTS SOUGHT IN THE BID DOCUMENT, ATC AND CORRIGENDUM IF ANY. XI. ALL THE DOCUMENTS UPLOADED SHOULD BE ON BIDDER'S LETTERHEAD. DOCUMENTS CLEARLY SPECI FYING THE ACCEPTANCE OF ALL THE TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS, ADDITIONAL SPECIFICATION PARAMETE RS AND TERMS & CONDITIONS SHOULD BE UPLOADED. XII. NOTE TO BIDDER: - IN THE EVENT OF ORDER, THE CONTRACTOR SHOULD SUPPLY THE MATERIAL WITH IN THE ORIGINAL DELIVERY PERIOD MENTIONED IN THE CONTRACT. IF NOT, THE HINDRANCE REGISTER SH OULD BE SUBMITTED WHICH IS MANDATORY DOCUMENT FOR CONSIDERATION OF GRANTING DP EXTENSI ON (IF REQUIRED). THE CONTRACTOR IS REQUIRED TO MAINTAIN HINDRANCE REGISTER FOR REPORTING HINDRANCE, IF ANY, WHILE EXECUTING THE WORK, AS PER ANNEXURE-X. THE CONTRACTOR SHALL GET RECORD OF HINDRAN CES IN THE HINDRANCE REGISTER(S) APPROVED/ENDORSED BY THE PURCHASER. SUCH HINDRANCE IN TH E WORK ENDORSED BY THE PURCHASER WILL ONLY BE TAKEN INTO CONSIDERATION FOR GRANTING DELI VERY DATE RE-FIXATION. XIII. INSTALLATION & COMMISSIONING: INSTALLATION & COMMISSIONING OF THE ITEM WILL BE UNDER SC OPE OF SUPPLIER. IT WOULD BE THE RESPONSIBILITY OF THE CONTRACTOR TO ARRANGE POLICE VERIFIC ATION CERTIFICATE FOR HIS WORKMEN/TECHNICIANS/ENGINEERS TO ENABLE CARRYING OUT INSTALLATIO N/ERECTION COMMISSIONING OF THE INSTRUMENT/EQUIPMENT/PLANT, INSIDE THE PURCHASER’S PREMIS ES. XIV. WORKMANS COMPENSATION ACT: (IN CASE OF INSTALLATION & COMMISSIONING ONLY) THE CONTRA CTOR SHALL AT ALL TIMES INDEMNIFY THE PURCHASER AGAINST ANY CLAI M WHCH MAY BE MADE UNDER THE WORKMAN'S COMPENSATION ACT 1923 OR ANY ST ATUTORY MODIFICATIONS THEREOF OR OTHERWI SE FOR IN RESPECT OF ANY DAMAGE OR INJURY ETC. SUSTAINED BY ANY WORKER OR PERSON IN THE EMP LOYMENT OF THE CONTRACTOR. XV. . Bidder’s qualifying Criteria: a) Bidder must prepare and submit signed and stamped compliance chart (attached as Annexu re II) along with the quotation. b) The bidder shall provide relevant OEM catalogues / datasheets for the supplied upgradation kit along with the offer. XVI. Acceptance criteria: a) Item has to be supplied in original OEM packaging. b) The supplied Smart SEM software, workstation, monitor, communication interfaces, and per ipherals shall be genuine OEM products and shall conform to the technical specifications. c) If there is change of “Product name” or “Part No” during offer/order confirmation/proforma invoice/supply” the final acceptance will be made after receiving written confirmation from th e supplier that the offered items serves the same or better technical functionality/specificatio ns and compatible with existing system as mentioned in the specification. d) After successful upgradation vendor shall ensure the following: i. The SmartSEM software shall be successfully installed, activated, and licensed on the suppli ed workstation. ii. The workstation shall be fully integrated with the existing ZEISS SUPRA-55 FESEM and all as sociated microscope subsystems.

iii. The upgraded system shall establish successful communication between the workstation a nd the FESEM without any hardware or software compatibility issues. iv. All microscope control functions, including stage control, imaging control, vacuum system operation, detector operation, beam parameter control, image acquisition, image processing, data storage, and data export functions, shall operate satisfactorily through the upgraded Sm artSEM software. v. Communication with existing compatible peripherals, accessories, and third-party devices c onnected through the specified interfaces shall be verified and demonstrated. vi. The workstation shall boot successfully, load the SmartSEM software without errors, and o perate reliably under normal microscope operating conditions. vii. Functional testing and performance verification of the upgraded FESEM system shall be ca rried out by an OEM-authorized service engineer at the consignee site. viii. Successful acquisition, display, storage, retrieval, and transfer of SEM images shall be de monstrated. ix. After successful installation and commissioning, the vendor shall demonstrate stable, relia ble, and error-free operation of the complete FESEM system for a minimum of one full working day before at least three VECC personnel nominated by the purchaser. x. All software licenses, installation media (if applicable), user documentation, and warranty/s upport documents shall be handed over to the consignee. xi. Basic operational training/familiarization on the upgraded SmartSEM software and worksta tion shall be provided to the designated users. e) Final acceptance shall be carried out at the consignee location and shall be subject to succe ssful demonstration of the upgraded FESEM system, including full functionality of the updated software, by an OEM-authorized representative . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 4. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 5. Generic Scope of supply includes Training: Number of employees to be trained 3 , Place for Training VEC Centre, Sector-1, Block-AF, Bidhan Nagar, Slat Lake, Kolkata-700064 and Duration of training 1 days.
